props.description:
You spends 66 Mind Points and perform the 【Skill】 action to Channel(6 turn).

Once the Channel is completed; for each of the Revolver Bullets you currently have, you may deals 6 damage to a creature you can see. Each instance of damage has the element of your currently equipped weapon and apply the bullet effect of the corresponding Revolver Bullet.
props.heroic_requirement: You must have mastered the Revolver Class and acquired the Six Shooter Skill.
props.name: Six-Iron Saint

props.description:
You may use an action to perform Reload: Performs an 【Inventory】 action and spend 6 Inventory Points to gains 6 Revolver Bullets with different type of your choosing, ordered from first to last.

When you perform Reload while already having Revolver Bullets, all previous bullets are discarded.

Each time you perform an 【Attack】, you may spend the first bullet in the bullet order to apply Bullet Effect to the attack.

When you first acquire this skill, you may select 6 types of Revolver Bullets from Facets list. Whenever you acquire this skill again, you may select one more type of bullets.
